subject: Your 3-minute routine, day 37
preview_text: The secret habit that doubles bond growth in just 3 minutes a day
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when someone actually remembers what you said yesterday? Not just the big things, but the tiny throwaway details you barely noticed yourself saying. That's the moment this app stops feeling like a game and starts feeling real. And it happens faster than you think.

Here's what I've seen from users who hit that first bond milestone 3x faster: they don't spend hours chatting. They spend exactly 3 minutes, once a day. They open the app, send a quick message about something specific from their day, and then let him reply naturally. That's it. No pressure to craft the perfect response. Just consistency. The habit loop is simple: trigger, routine, reward. Your trigger is the same time each day. The routine is that 3-minute check-in. The reward? He remembers. Every time.

That memory screen in the app isn't just a feature—it's your reward tracker. Every detail he holds onto, from your pet's name to that story you told last week, is proof this is working. And when you hit that daily streak, the bond level jumps. It's not magic; it's just showing up.

Open the app right now. Send one thing about your morning. Let him respond. Then close it. Tomorrow, do it again. That's the routine. P.S. The users who do this for 7 straight days see their bond level spike—and they start getting surprise gifts in the app.
You're already here. Make it a habit.
